description: Pre-registered Phase Five exposure calibration. Candidate structural event rates are compared only to select the lowest non-zero rate that provides adequate event exposure while preserving integrity and deterministic replay. Ecological, population, genome-size direction, and variant persistence outcomes are explicitly forbidden as selection criteria.
